% Checks cases the fix of \UseVerb must not break: fancyvrb's saved
% verbatim blocks, shown with \UseVerbatim, \BUseVerbatim, and
% \LUseVerbatim, stay displays, and \Verb stays inline.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,fancyvrb}
\begin{document}
\begin{SaveVerbatim}{blk}
uv-block a_b{c}%
  uv-block-indent #1
\end{SaveVerbatim}
Before the block.
\UseVerbatim{blk}
Between, \Verb|uv-plain a_b| inline.
\BUseVerbatim{blk}
Then a numbered one.
\LUseVerbatim{blk}
After the blocks.
\end{document}
